pages.title: A Snow Team
pages.text: Hitch a tamed wolf to a sled, install a chest and carry items over snow or ice.

pages.title: A Snow Team
pages.text: Lights decorate a winter stop and eggnog supplies the next outing after the wolf team’s first job.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use a lead to hitch your wolf. A chest or supported storage container carries cargo. Slopes give momentum and the wolf helps uphill.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Ride a sled over snow or ice and turn to control its movement. Follow slopes and gain downhill momentum.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Attach a tamed wolf to a sled with a Lead. Improve sled mobility and uphill travel.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place a Chest or supported storage container on a sled. Carry cargo during snow travel.
